_doc: pla-01 exception strip (director 2026-11-20): short glossary copy that supersedes the tt-01/tt-02/trp-01 fixtures, and the Grimoire lines that now hold the detail cut from tooltips. Read by tests/test_short_card_tooltips.py, tests/short_card_tooltips_test.gd, tests/text_budget_test.py and tests/test_card_panel_text.py; the historical fixtures stay untouched.

glossary.traps: Traps hit when entered or attacked, then leave ground on that tile and each adjacent tile.
glossary.summon_minions: This enemy adds the named enemy to combat.
glossary.lightning_storm: On each Lightning Storm beat, each unit on an Electrified tile takes X damage.
glossary.guard_ally: This enemy gives X Block to each shown ally.
glossary.heal_ally: This enemy restores X Health to the named ally.
glossary.all_enemies: Hit each visible enemy that meets the named condition.
glossary.reflect: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.
glossary.skill_measured_breath: At turn end, bank up to one unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn.
glossary.skill_confluence: Once per combat, move ground between 2 visible tiles within @icon(range) 4 of you and each other.

keyword:marked: Burrowed enemies cannot be targeted or moved. Area attacks hit Burrowed enemies. A Burrow Grub emerges on the Marked tile or the nearest open tile.
keyword:burst: Kindle adds up to 4 damage to the Ember Tick's Burst.
keyword:blink: A Gloam Stalker's Fade lands on another adjacent tile if the tile behind you is blocked.
combat:boss_eclipse: Braziers still relight and Shades from Snuff still leave when the enemy's turn is skipped.

card_panel_text.meteorfall: Next turn before you Draw, deal {n} damage and leave Fire on each Marked tile.
card_panel_text.unchanged_creates_one_illusion_on_each_e: Create 1 Illusion on each empty tile adjacent to you.
card_panel_text.illusion_nearby: This attack also hits each other enemy adjacent to one of your Illusions once.
